svg.title: VoiceLoop system architecture
svg.desc: Detailed current architecture of VoiceLoop from local inputs through capture, deterministic routing, bounded context, model planning, policy, execution, adapters, and observation.
svg.text: VoiceLoop - System Architecture
Detailed current flow: deterministic control around bounded model planning
INPUTS
Four entry paths, one request contract
Sources: panel, deepgram, voiceattack, api, n8n
CAPTURE + STT
TranscriptEnvelopeV1
raw + normalized text, confidence, words, speaker IDs, final flags
INTAKE + DETERMINISTIC GATES
AssistantService.handle owns the turn
• build CommandRequest and persist the received command
• deduplicate normalized text within the 2 second window
• STOP, pause, conversation-end, STT and speaker gates run first
A protected deterministic result never waits for retrieval or an LLM.
ROUTING LANES
Rules decide when generation is needed
LIVE - Router V1
STOP, voice test, capabilities, simple actions and guards
SHADOW - Routing V2
segmenter → capability search → resolver → assembler
OPTIONAL - n8n is off by default; failure falls through safely
V2 executes only behind explicit quality and configuration gates.
TURNCONTEXT
Ephemeral context for one turn
Task planning receives no tool observations; conversation may receive bounded ones.
Retrieved text is data. It cannot create intent, action, permission, or success.
RETRIEVAL - TWO SEPARATE COLLECTIONS
voiceloop_memory
5 axes: semantic .40, topic .20, intent .15,
decision .15, person_context .10; weighted RRF k=60
SQLite partner
memories + semantic
vector fallback
capabilities_v1
semantic, intent,
target_context - V2 only
Capability vectors are never merged into personal memory.
PLAN CONTRACT
The model proposes; local code binds
ProposedPlan
intent, response, confidence, clarification, max 12 steps
CommandPlan
known actions, UUID dependencies, locally bound targets
Unknown action, bad edge, or fake success claim rejects every step.
POLICY + CONFIRMATION
ActionRegistry is the authority boundary
• action_id must exist in the registered local allowlist
• arguments must match strict per-action JSON schemas
• model risk can never lower the registered risk
• medium actions keep confirmation when locally required
Desktop identity is revalidated and bound before consent.
No valid policy result reaches the executor queue.
EXECUTION
One queue, one active plan, typed results
submit → bind targets → enforce policy → queue → handler
ActionResult(success, message, data)
Only the executor result can establish that work succeeded.
deterministic plan bypass
PERSISTENCE + OBSERVATION
Canonical records stay local and inspectable
SSE events, health cards, source links, and turn traces expose the live pipeline.
Observation may inform a later turn; it never becomes a new command by itself.
ACTION ADAPTERS
Capabilities are explicit and bounded
Handlers return messages and structured data; executor wraps them as ActionResult.
There is no general cmd.exe or PowerShell tool available to the model.
How to read this
CORE IDEA
The model may propose a typed plan.
Local code owns action identity, risk,
confirmation, execution, and success.
Safety boundaries
STOP / PRZERWIJ
Deterministic plan calls stop_all().
Pending consent, queue, and active task cancel.
SITUATIONSTATE V1
Read-only to planning; no action mutation.
COMMITMENT LAYER
Text analysis only; not an execution trigger.
TRUST BOUNDARY
Memory, screen text, and web results
are untrusted context. They cannot add
an action or lower a confirmation rule.
EXAMPLE TURN TIMELINE - FROM UTTERANCE TO VERIFIED RESULT
At every stage, failure stays explicit: clarification, rejected, cancelled, failed, or a typed success result.
VoiceLoop | architecture infographic v2 | based on current repository contracts
Canonical details: docs/ARCHITECTURE_CURRENT.md
